🚀 CHIMERA II OS - COMPLETE DOCKER BUILD, PUSH & DEPLOYMENT SYSTEM

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

✅ WHAT WAS CREATED

Complete end-to-end Docker automation system:

1. DOCKER BUILD & PUSH SCRIPT (23 KB)
   ✓ docker-build-push.sh
   • Bash script for WSL2/Linux
   • Clone/update all 13 GitHub repositories
   • Build Docker image for each repository
   • Create Dockerfile if missing
   • Tag with: latest, v1.0.0, stable
   • Login to Docker Hub
   • Push all 39 images (with rate limiting)
   • Verify uploads
   • Generate comprehensive report
   • Runtime: 1-2 hours

2. WINDOWS WRAPPER (7 KB)
   ✓ docker-build-push-wsl2.ps1
   • PowerShell script for Windows users
   • WSL2 integration
   • Pre-flight prerequisite checks
   • Build progress monitoring
   • Automatic results display
   • Configuration options

3. DOCKER COMPOSE STACK (7 KB)
   ✓ docker-compose-full.yml
   • 13 Chimera services
   • PostgreSQL database with persistence
   • Redis cache
   • RabbitMQ message queue
   • Nginx API gateway
   • Custom networking (172.25.0.0/16)
   • Health checks for all services
   • Resource limits and requests
   • Restart policies

4. KUBERNETES MANIFESTS (10.5 KB)
   ✓ kubernetes-deployment.yaml
   • Namespace: chimera-system
   • Deployments: core, nlp, business (with pod replicas)
   • StatefulSets: PostgreSQL, Redis (persistent storage)
   • Services: LoadBalancer (external), ClusterIP (internal)
   • ConfigMaps: Shared configuration
   • Secrets: Sensitive data (DB/Redis passwords)
   • HorizontalPodAutoscaler: Auto-scaling based on CPU/memory
   • NetworkPolicy: Security policies
   • Ingress: External routing and TLS
   • Ready for production

5. COMPREHENSIVE GUIDE (9.5 KB)
   ✓ DOCKER_BUILD_PUSH_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md
   • Quick start (3 commands)
   • Build process explanation
   • Deployment options (Docker, Compose, Kubernetes)
   • Step-by-step examples
   • Troubleshooting guide
   • Pull & run examples
   • Docker Hub links
   • Compose file documentation
   • Kubernetes deployment guide

🚀 QUICK START (Build & Push to Docker Hub)

1. Windows PowerShell (Administrator):
   cd C:\tmp\ChimeraIIOS

2. Start Docker build and push:
   .\docker-build-push-wsl2.ps1

3. Wait 1-2 hours for build and push to complete...

4. Verify on Docker Hub:
   https://hub.docker.com/u/amerhwitat

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🎬 BUILD PROCESS (7 Steps)

Step 1: Initialize Build Environment (1 min)
  • Create build directories
  • Check Git, Docker, disk space
  • Initialize logging

Step 2: Clone or Update Repositories (5-10 min)
  • Clone 13 repositories from GitHub
  • Update existing repositories
  • Location: ~/docker-build-chimera/repos/

Step 3: Build Docker Images (30-60 min)
  • Build image for each repository
  • Create Dockerfile if missing
  • Tag: latest, v1.0.0, stable
  • Add labels and metadata

Step 4: Docker Hub Authentication (1 min)
  • Login to Docker Hub
  • Accept credentials or PAT
  • Verify authentication

Step 5: Push Docker Images (20-40 min)
  • Push all 39 images to Docker Hub
  • 2-second rate limiting between pushes
  • Verify each push succeeds

Step 6: Verify Pushed Images (5 min)
  • Check Docker Hub API
  • Confirm all images uploaded
  • List all available images

Step 7: Generate Build Report (2 min)
  • Create detailed report
  • Docker Hub links
  • Deployment examples

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

📊 DEPLOYMENT OPTIONS

Option 1: Docker (Single Host)
  ✓ Pull image: docker pull amerhwitat/chimeraiios:latest
  ✓ Run container: docker run -it amerhwitat/chimeraiios:latest bash
  ✓ Run with volumes: docker run -it -v $(pwd):/workspace amerhwitat/chimeraiios:latest
  ✓ Run in background: docker run -d amerhwitat/chimeraiios:latest

Option 2: Docker Compose (Multi-Service, Single Host)
  ✓ 13 Chimera services
  ✓ PostgreSQL database
  ✓ Redis cache
  ✓ RabbitMQ queue
  ✓ Nginx gateway
  ✓ Start: docker-compose -f docker-compose-full.yml up -d
  ✓ Stop: docker-compose -f docker-compose-full.yml down

Option 3: Kubernetes (Multi-Node Cluster)
  ✓ Production-ready manifests
  ✓ Auto-scaling (HorizontalPodAutoscaler)
  ✓ Persistent storage (PostgreSQL, Redis)
  ✓ Network policies
  ✓ Ingress routing
  ✓ Deploy: kubectl apply -f kubernetes-deployment.yaml

🎯 DOCKER COMPOSE DEPLOYMENT

docker-compose-full.yml includes:

Services (13):
  • chimera-core - Main OS service (port 8000)
  • nlp-service - NLP/AI (port 8002)
  • business-service - BizX (port 3000)
  • enterprise-service - BizXtreme (port 8003)
  • cpu-simulator - CPU4096 (port 8004)
  • cpu-simulator-web - Web UI (port 3002)
  • crypto-service - keygen (port 8005)
  • ethereum-service - Ethereum (port 8006)
  • security-service - bruteforce (port 8007)
  • pdf-service - PDF processing (port 8008)
  • utils-service - utilities (port 8009)
  • test-service - testing (port 8010)
  • portfolio-service - portfolio (port 3003)

Infrastructure:
  • chimera-database (PostgreSQL)
  • chimera-cache (Redis)
  • chimera-queue (RabbitMQ)
  • chimera-gateway (Nginx)

Usage:
  docker-compose -f docker-compose-full.yml up -d
  docker-compose -f docker-compose-full.yml logs -f
  docker-compose -f docker-compose-full.yml ps
  docker-compose -f docker-compose-full.yml down

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

☸️ KUBERNETES DEPLOYMENT

kubernetes-deployment.yaml includes:

Namespace:
  • chimera-system (isolated namespace)

Deployments:
  • chimera-core (3 replicas, auto-scaling 2-10)
  • nlp-service (2 replicas)
  • business-service (2 replicas)

StatefulSets:
  • chimera-postgres (PostgreSQL, 1 replica, 10GB storage)
  • chimera-redis (Redis, 1 replica, 5GB storage)

Services:
  • LoadBalancer: chimera-core, business-service
  • ClusterIP: nlp-service, chimera-postgres, chimera-redis

Configuration:
  • ConfigMap: shared configuration
  • Secrets: database and cache passwords
  • Resource limits and requests
  • Health checks (liveness, readiness)

Security:
  • NetworkPolicy: pod-to-pod communication
  • RBAC ready (add roles as needed)
  • Secret management

Auto-scaling:
  • HorizontalPodAutoscaler (CPU 70%, Memory 80%)
  • Min 2 replicas, max 10

Usage:
  kubectl apply -f kubernetes-deployment.yaml
  kubectl get all -n chimera-system
  kubectl scale deployment chimera-core --replicas=5 -n chimera-system
  kubectl logs deployment/chimera-core -n chimera-system
  kubectl delete namespace chimera-system

✅ SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

Minimum:
  • 8GB RAM
  • 50GB free disk space
  • 4 CPU cores
  • 1-2 hours available time

Recommended:
  • 16GB+ RAM
  • 100GB+ free disk space
  • 8+ CPU cores
  • 1-2 hours uninterrupted

Software:
  ✓ Windows 10/11 with WSL2
  ✓ Ubuntu 20.04+ on WSL2
  ✓ Docker installed on WSL2
  ✓ Git configured
  ✓ GCC/Make available (optional)

📋 EXAMPLE WORKFLOWS

Workflow 1: Build, Push & Deploy with Docker Compose (2 hours)
  1. Run: .\docker-build-push-wsl2.ps1
  2. Wait for completion (1-2 hours)
  3. Deploy: docker-compose -f docker-compose-full.yml up -d
  4. Access services on localhost

Workflow 2: Build, Push & Deploy to Kubernetes (2 hours)
  1. Run: .\docker-build-push-wsl2.ps1
  2. Wait for completion (1-2 hours)
  3. Deploy: kubectl apply -f kubernetes-deployment.yaml
  4. Access: kubectl port-forward svc/chimera-core 8000:8000

Workflow 3: Build, Push & Test Individual Images (1-2 hours)
  1. Run: .\docker-build-push-wsl2.ps1
  2. Wait for completion
  3. Test: docker pull amerhwitat/chimeraiios:latest
  4. Run: docker run -it amerhwitat/chimeraiios:latest bash
